title: Can Gemini’s New Mac Agent Actually Handle Your Daily Admin Tasks?
description:
Google just launched a new desktop agent for Mac that clicks and types for you, but does it actually save time or just add another layer of permission-based friction? We’re breaking down the reality of agentic AI in your workflow.

What we covered:
• Google introduces computer use in the Gemini app for Mac
• SpaceX's Cursor evaluates phasing out Chinese AI models due to geopolitical risk
• Apple Reportedly Developing Its Own 'Agentic' AI Assistant for macOS

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: When you delegate a task to an AI, do you treat it like a tool or a junior coworker?

What to watch next: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.

What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
